title: Snow Chieftain
html:
Algor the Cold,the Snow Chieftain

Algor the Cold (Algor's Terror Dome) Level 10-25

The main Snow Chieftain, Algor The Cold, located at the end of Algor's Terror Dome is a giant Ice Orok Chieftain. He will hit an unprepared player hard with knockback and take some good hits himself, so it's a smart user who takes along a lot of healing potions to use during combat. He is protected by two Ice Orok Juggernaut Champions. Area of Attack skills come in handy here to use against the Ice Sprite fodder mobs who will swarm around you.

Ingame, players often refer to Algor and/or this dungeon as SC and will use it to designate a specific farming group, such as "LFG SC".

Skills:

  • Knockback Charge
  • Mortal Strike (can one shot you)

Resistances:

  • Low Poison Resist
  • No Fire Resist
  • Very High Ice Resist
  • Low Shadow Resist
  • No Divine Resist

For tips on fighting the Snow Chieftain, check out Snow Chieftain Boss Guide.
